title: Extract generic UOS kernel from AI_book into standalone UOS
acceptance: Copy only generic kernel docs tools schemas tests and templates; remove AI_BOOK assumptions; preserve provider-neutral git+python lifecycle and current ownership Lease Fencing CAS invariants; do not copy AI_book private project content or runtime claims/grants/done; produce an explicit upstream kernel manifest and standalone boot path
notes: First extraction task. Keep paths stable where practical and do not claim standalone acceptance before regressions pass.

title: Add standalone project init and task publish flow
acceptance: Provide deterministic file/Git-backed project initialization and task publication; creating tasks must never create ownership; newly published READY tasks become discoverable after reconcile; add focused tests for project init task publish dependencies duplicate ID rejection and no synthetic Claim/Grant/Done
notes: This is the missing operator authoring layer needed for UOS to create and publish new work like AI_book.

title: Create versioned UOS to consumer sync and pin mechanism
acceptance: Define a machine-readable KERNEL_SYNC manifest and UOS_PIN_V1; sync only versioned kernel artifacts from UOS to a consumer such as AI_book; runtime-local claims grants leases done and project content must never cross repositories; detect downstream drift and require explicit upstreaming or override
notes: UOS must be the single kernel source of truth while AI_book can stay pinned to a tested snapshot.

title: Prove standalone UOS can schedule and improve itself
acceptance: With provider automation disabled prove fresh clone boot project init task publish claim work renew completion reconcile next-task lifecycle; verify unique ownership and fenced reclaim under 1/2/5/10/30 agents; verify crash/restart recovery; verify UOS_CORE can publish and claim its own next task; verify a pinned kernel sync into a clean consumer without transferring runtime state
notes: Acceptance gate before declaring standalone UOS V1 release.
